Fixed upstream commits, license/use records and public/private separation; exact admitted source paths, byte hashes, sizes and inclusion/ignore reasons; query/gold/config/scoring and actual source-manifest locks. A documented public source subset is allowed, but cannot be represented as an entire checkout/dependency closure.

Retain the ten original categories in actual coverage. Each included question is grounded in the fixed source, with primary/supporting/alternative roles reviewed by a non-author and hard negatives that are lexically plausible but wrong. Version disagreements and quarantine them; do not silently delete hard questions or relabel to preserve scores.

Native IDs, query_family, intent/scope, answer groups, required evidence/facets and applicable spans/symbol/graph constraints must have their declared semantics. File hits cannot be reported as graph correctness. Unsupported capabilities remain explicit and separate from the admitted supported scope.

Assign translations/paraphrases by query_family, preserve DEV versus protected material, review global correlated components using the actual current public bytes and report correlations honestly. Repeated questions or mechanical duplicate absence are not proof of independent statistical units.

Run the original schema/lock/format path on the complete admitted public candidate; bind exact files and actually reject identity/schema drift. Preserve original scorer version and no-answer/compat denominator differences. A metadata recovery utility alone is insufficient.

Report actual rows/families/components, per-repo/category/language coverage, unsupported abilities, gold review scope and any approximate600 planning shortfall separately. Public/native and compat are separate profiles. Report unrun runtime-quality/macros/heldout/live/fullV19/G8 as not_run/blocked/inconclusive as applicable; do not certify those outcomes by closing this corpus task.
